title: 超音波換能器電子系統
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究聲電諧振、回波與飛行時間；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate electroacoustic resonance, echoes and time of flight. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

stages.title: 傳播與換能
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「傳播與換能」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for propagation and transduction.

Sound speed changes with medium/environment; air values do not apply to liquids. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「超音波換能器電子系統」的「聲速與環境：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「訊號診所：雜訊與錯頻」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Sound speed and environment: model and design” in “Ultrasonic-transducer electronics”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Signal Clinic: Noise and Aliasing” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「聲速與環境」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for sound speed and environment?
options: 聲速隨介質和環境改變，不可把空氣值用於液體。
換能器頻率響應只由靜態電容決定。
optionsEn: Sound speed changes with medium/environment; air values do not apply to liquids.
Sound speed is identical in all media.
Transducer response depends only on static capacitance.
quiz.explanation: 聲速隨介質和環境改變，不可把空氣值用於液體。 比较不同假設聲速造成的距離偏差。
quiz.explanationEn: Sound speed changes with medium/environment; air values do not apply to liquids. Compare distance bias under different assumed sound speeds.

steps.title: 聲速與環境：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Sound speed and environment: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「聲速與環境」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in sound speed and environment, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。比较不同假設聲速造成的距離偏差。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「聲速隨介質和環境改變，不可把空氣值用於液體。」和待排除假說「所有介質的聲速相同。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Compare distance bias under different assumed sound speeds. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Sound speed changes with medium/environment; air values do not apply to liquids.” with the hypothesis to reject “Sound speed is identical in all media.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：比较不同假設聲速造成的距離偏差。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Compare distance bias under different assumed sound speeds. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 比较不同假設聲速造成的距離偏差。
steps.observationEn: Compare distance bias under different assumed sound speeds.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：所有介質的聲速相同。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: Sound speed is identical in all media. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.text: 單站脈衝回波距離 d=c·Δt/2。 單一反射路徑與固定聲速近似；溫度、濕度、氣流和多路徑需另外評估。
knowledge.textEn: Monostatic pulse-echo distance d=c·Δt/2. Single reflection path and fixed sound speed; temperature, humidity, flow and multipath require additional assessment.

quiz.question: 審查「方向與目標」時，哪項主張或判別方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or diagnostic is justified for beam and target?
options: 比較平面正對與傾斜目標的反射路徑。
相同距離的所有物體必有相同回波強度。
增加激發週期只會改善所有測距性能。
optionsEn: Compare normal and tilted target reflection paths.
All targets at equal distance produce equal echoes.
More burst cycles improve every ranging metric.
quiz.explanation: 波束角、目標面積和傾角決定回波能量。 比較平面正對與傾斜目標的反射路徑。
quiz.explanationEn: Beam angle, target area and tilt determine echo energy. Compare normal and tilted target reflection paths.
